snippet.title: Typing Land - A fun and exciting FREE typing game
snippet.description:
Learn how to type through 40 kinds of mini-games!
https://typingland.higopage.com/

- All 81 lessons are free to play.
- Completely kids-friendly and ads-free.
- Learn from basics including how to position the fingers.
- Once installed, games can be played offline.

#iOS #Windows #Chromebook #android #iPad #Mac #TouchType #TypingGame
